bug: Checkout total off by one cent for carts with three or more discounted items

hypotheses.statement: Something weird with rounding somewhere in the discount code
Per-line discounts are rounded before summing instead of after
hypotheses.prediction: If per-line rounding is the cause, then summing unrounded line discounts makes the total match the reference calculation
hypotheses.experiment: Swap the order of round() and sum() in apply_discounts behind a flag; rerun the loop

experiments.change: Switched to decimal arithmetic and upgraded the currency library
